assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: fullscreen 16:9 background for the Collection and Achievements screen of Eterno Retorno, a dark medieval fantasy pixel-art deckbuilding RPG. Create a richly detailed pixel art gothic hall of memories, dark stone vaulted archive with aged armor, old books, subtle violet spectral mist and candlelight. Thin blackened silver architectural ornaments, worn stone pillars concentrated at far left and right edges, a distant empty altar centered high in the background. Most of central 80 percent is very dark uncluttered shadow to support readable UI tiles layered on top. Atmospheric and mature, crisp pixel clusters, restrained muted purple charcoal silver with small warm gold lights, consistent with dark fantasy game menus. No characters, no text, no letters, no UI, no buttons, no watermark. Landscape 1536x1024 or wider.
